intent: Capture a privacy-safe structural runtime fingerprint that can be compared across authorized Frida sessions for recognition, drift and stability analysis.

stable_identity: Android/ART build identity when Java is available
token_vazio: kernel LMKD cause without independent evidence
SELinux causal attribution without denial evidence
physical memory pressure without a measured source

invariants: stable identity drift and runtime drift are reported separately
runtime drift is not automatically classified as instability
absence of a source remains TOKEN_VAZIO
a dump is evidence, not a causal claim
the agent never repairs, resumes, patches or mutates the target
